'''Alexander Moiseevich Olevskii''' ({{Langx|ru|Александр Моисеевич Олевский}};<ref>Name and transliteration as from {{cite web|url=https://www.mathnet.ru/php/person.phtml?personid=14013|title=Олевский Александр Моисеевич|work=Mathnet|publisher=Steklov Mathematical Institute RAS|access-date=2024-04-10}}</ref> born February 12, 1939, in Moscow) is a Russian-Israeli mathematician at [[Tel Aviv University]], specializing in [[mathematical analysis]].<ref name="bio">{{cite web|website=REAL ANALYSIS EXCHANGE, Summer Symposium in Real Analysis XXXIX, "The Cows and Colleges Symposium", St. Olaf College|title=Alexander Olevskii, Professor of Mathematics, Tel-Aviv University|url=https://www.stolaf.edu/analysis/Northfield2015/Web2015/olevskii.html}}</ref> As of July 2021, he is a [[professor emeritus]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Prof. Alexander Olevskii {{!}} Faculty of Exact Sciences Raymond & Beverly Sackler|url=https://en-exact-sciences.tau.ac.il/profile/olevskii|access-date=2021-07-26|website=en-exact-sciences.tau.ac.il}}</ref>

He graduated in 1963 with a [[Candidate of Sciences]] degree (PhD) from [[Moscow State University]].<ref name=MathGen>{{MathGenealogy|id=103090}}</ref> There he received in 1966 a Russian [[Doctor of Sciences]] degree (habilitation).<ref name=bio/>  At the [[Moscow Institute of Electronics and Mathematics]], he was from 1988 to 1992 head of the department of algebra and analysis. In the spring of 1996 he was at the [[Institute for Advanced Study]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Alexander Olevskii|website=Institute for Advanced Study|date=9 December 2019|url=https://www.ias.edu/scholars/alexander-olevskii}}</ref> He has held visiting appointments at universities or institutes in several countries, including France, Australia, Germany, Italy, and the United States.<ref name=bio/>

In 1986 Olevskii was an invited speaker at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] in [[Berkeley, California]].<ref>{{cite book|author=Олевский, А. М.|title=Proceedings of the International Congress of Mathematicians, August 3–11, 1986, Berkeley, California|year=1986|volume=2|pages=976–989|chapter=Гомеоморфизмы окружности, модификации функций и ряды Фурье (Homeomorphisms of the circle, modifications of functions and Fourier series)}}</ref> He was a member of the 2013 Class of Fellows of the [[American Mathematical Society]] (announced in 2012).<ref>{{cite web|title=List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society|website=ams.org|url=http://www.ams.org/cgi-bin/fellows/fellows.cgi#o}}</ref> In 2014 he was an invited speaker at the [[European Congress of Mathematics]] in [[Kraków]].<ref>{{cite book|author=Olevskii, Alexander|chapter=Sampling, interpolation, translates|title=European Congress of Mathematics Kraków, 2–7 July, 2012|pages=489–502|year=2014|publisher=European Mathematical Society |isbn=978-3-03719-120-0}} (online {{isbn|978-3-03719-620-5}})</ref>

His doctoral students include [[Gady Kozma]].<ref name=MathGen/>
